how_to_apply: Download the application form from the Thanjavur district website (https://thanjavur.nic.in) or the National Health Mission website (http://nhm.tn.gov.in).

Fill in the form for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, with the personal, educational, Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration, community and district details it asks for, and affix a photograph.

important_instructions: The Staff Nurse posts are entirely contractual and temporary under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu. content_sections.heading: About Thanjavur District Health Society
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Thanjavur District, works under the Health and Family Welfare Department and issues this notice through the Executive Secretary, who is also the Deputy Director of Health Services, Thanjavur. The Staff Nurse posts are under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu.

content_sections.text: As of 20 November 2026, the application window is still open.

content_sections.heading: Thanjavur District Health Society Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice announces 127 vacancies for one post. The posts are subject to change in number. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the 127 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Thanjavur District Health Society Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Proof of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard mark sheet) is among the mandatory documents. The applicant must serve in the post for a minimum of 2 years. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing (Government or Government-recognised private nursing college; recognised by the Indian Nursing Council). Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Thanjavur District Health Society Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Thanjavur District Health Society Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The decision of the selection committee members is final, according to the notice. Applicants must give a self-willing undertaking letter to join the post and a contract letter for 11 months. The application form refers to "scoring criteria", for which any relevant certificate is to be attached; the notice does not describe the criteria.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Thanjavur District Health Society Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Thanjavur district website ( https://thanjavur.nic.in ) or the National Health Mission website ( http://nhm.tn.gov.in ). Fill in the form for the post of Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse, with the personal, educational, Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration, community and district details it asks for, and affix a photograph. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates the notice lists. Mark sheets for all years must be attached separately. Attach a character and conduct certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months. Submit the application in person or by post to: Executive Secretary, District Health Society and Deputy Director of Health Services, Office of the Deputy Director of Health Services, Gandhiji Road, Near LIC Building, Thanjavur, 613 001. Telephone: 04362-273503. Make sure the application is received by 5:00 PM on 04-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth: Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate. Educational qualification and marks: SSLC, HSC, DGNM / B.Sc Nursing certificate. Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate with valid date. Proof of Tamil eligibility: 10th or 12th standard mark sheet. Proof of residence, any one: Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Ration Card. Character and conduct certificate from a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated within the last 3 months. Community Certificate and two recent passport-size colour photographs. Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, wherever applicable. Where applicable, a priority certificate (Transgender / Ex-Serviceman / Destitute Widow): UDID card for transgender applicants, and for others a certificate issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Thanjavur District Health Society Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurse posts are entirely contractual and temporary under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu. Contract is renewed after each period of 11 months on the basis of performance appraisal, as per the National Health Mission contract rules. The temporary post will not be converted into a permanent post, and services will not be regularised for any reason. The application form carries a declaration to this effect. The number of vacancies is subject to change. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 04-12-2026, and those without full details and the required certificates, will be rejected.

Staff Nurse notification of Thanjavur District Health Society

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are there in Thanjavur District Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 127 vacancies for contractual / temporary Staff Nurse posts in Thanjavur district under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 5:00 PM on 4 December 2026. Applications received after that time are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a government or government-recognised private nursing college. Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration is compulsory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years. The notice prints no age relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Staff Nurse here?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 21000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://thanjavur.nic.in or http://nhm.tn.gov.in, attach self-attested certificates and submit it in person or by post to the Executive Secretary, District Health Society and Deputy Director of Health Services, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission - Tamil Nadu, and the services will not be regularised for any reason.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: Applicants must give a contract letter for 11 months, and the contract is renewed after each 11 months on the basis of performance appraisal. The notice also requires a minimum of 2 years of service in the post.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Proof of date of birth, SSLC, HSC and nursing certificates, Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration, a Tamil eligibility proof, a residence proof, a character certificate, a Community Certificate and two photographs.
